changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: PRE-STACK SCHEMA CHANGE: Index ExtraField names, deletion flags and subtypes for exact-name hydration lookups. Hydrating a runtime field by its exact name uses the name prefix, deletion flag and subtype, so a selective name does not scan ExtraField; broader discovery queries do not use this index. The plain name predicate lets MariaDB use the prefix index beside the exact HEX identity. The cost is a modest write overhead on ExtraField.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_name_deleted ON ExtraField (name(128), deleted, DTYPE)

changeSet.author: tchoi-rs
changeSet.comment: PRE-STACK SCHEMA CHANGE: Index ExtraField owning instruments, names and deletion flags for correlated filters. On 100,000 instruments and 2,000,000 value rows, correlated runtime-field filters probe each owning instrument, then the name prefix and deletion flag. The plain name equality lets MariaDB use all three indexed columns. Its leading column overlaps the existing foreign-key index FK_ExtraField_to_InstrEntity. That index is kept deliberately: it belongs to the released schema, and dropping it is a separate schema change. This composite index could back the foreign key if it is dropped later.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_instr_name ON ExtraField (instrumentEntity_id, name(128), deleted)
